principles.artifact_truth: Managed output/.raw artifacts are SQLite-first and must use ArtifactStore/json_io proxies.
principles.source_truth: Live target source text may be read from the filesystem at canonical ingestion boundaries; downstream analyzers should prefer hash-bearing SQLite source snapshots when available.
principles.future_sqlite_first: Engines that combine Atlas/artifact scope with source text are either source snapshot consumers or migration candidates, not silent filesystem readers.

source_snapshot_table_markers: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_snapshots

canonical_source_ingestion.purpose: Create first-order source truth, file hashes, symbols, and snapshots from the live repository.
canonical_source_ingestion.allowed_scope: Discovery, AST sequencers, and Atlas generation only.
canonical_source_ingestion.sqlite_first_boundary: Not applicable before source truth exists; downstream consumers must use generated Atlas/source_snapshots.

execution_adapter.purpose: Materialize or inspect temporary execution/sanctuary files that must match the current filesystem.
execution_adapter.allowed_scope: Scoped validation and MCP governance smoke harnesses.
execution_adapter.sqlite_first_boundary: May read live scoped files; must not reinterpret managed analysis artifacts from shadow JSON.

merge_materialization_adapter.purpose: Read current source and variation files to build bounded merge/review material.
merge_materialization_adapter.allowed_scope: Merge transfer packages and generated merge scripts.
merge_materialization_adapter.sqlite_first_boundary: May read live merge inputs because merge application must operate on current files; metadata and graph scope still come from managed artifacts.

source_transformation_adapter.purpose: Perform explicit source transformation or repair work against current files.
source_transformation_adapter.sqlite_first_boundary: Live read is permitted only for the transformation target; analysis truth should come from Atlas/source snapshots.

project_manifest_reader.purpose: Read package/config manifests as project identity inputs.
project_manifest_reader.allowed_scope: Project DNA and discovery-adjacent manifest reads.
project_manifest_reader.sqlite_first_boundary: Manifests are declared inputs; resulting identity should be normalized into managed artifacts.

quality_hygiene_adapter.purpose: Run lightweight encoding/UTF-8 hygiene checks over selected files.
quality_hygiene_adapter.allowed_scope: Bounded quality gate hygiene checks only.
quality_hygiene_adapter.sqlite_first_boundary: Should not perform semantic source analysis; semantic consumers must use source_snapshots.

report_adapter.purpose: Assemble human-facing reports from generated report snippets.
report_adapter.sqlite_first_boundary: Must not create new source truth; should only render already generated evidence.
